title: The Unjust Steward
description: Jesus tells of a steward accused of wasting his master's possessions. Before losing his job, he reduces the debts owed to his master by the debtors to secure friends for himself. The master commends his shrewdness, and Jesus urges faithfulness, stating that one cannot serve both God and mammon.

versions.title: The Unjust Steward
versions.description: An unjust steward uses his shrewdness to secure his future – a challenging parable about stewardship.
